blocks.text: Bring more richness to your everyday coffee moments this season as Seattle’s Best Coffee brings an indulgent twist to the beloved Spanish Latte. Blending espresso with rich black cocoa and condensed milk, the collection brings together deep chocolate notes, creamy sweetness and a satisfying bittersweet finish in four crave-worthy ways. A Quartet of Premium Goodness The new collection balances the sweetness of a traditional Spanish Latte with a distinct bittersweet depth. By pairing espresso with rich black cocoa and milk, the lineup delivers a smooth balance in four distinct formats: Black Spanish Hot Latte: Hot drink made with espresso, milk and […]...
